pool.text: Bao'an County lost territory to Dongguan and was incorporated into it.
China leased the New Territories to Britain for ninety nine years.
Xin'an residents successfully rebelled and overthrew the local Qing administration.
The administration renamed Xin'an County back to Bao'an County.
Trade unions set up a reception station for strike workers.
Chen Jitang and his family established several casinos in Shenzhen.
The Japanese army tried crossing a bridge before British forces blew it.
The Bao'an County government decided to move to Shenzhen.
Shenzhen was developed from a rural village area into a city.
The Central Committee designated Shenzhen as the first SEZ.
From the establishment of Shenzhen as a SEZ, Hong Kong became its largest trade partner.
Opened in Shenzhen Normal School, which was later upgraded to Shenzhen Normal College.
The government erected barbed wire and checkpoints to enforce law.
The mainland China McDonald's restaurant opened in Luohu District, introducing American fast food.
The Shenzhen Stock Exchange was established under regulatory authority.
The Standing Committee granted the government local lawmaking power.
The State Council approved and established the Shenzhen High-tech Industrial Development Zone.
The Shenzhen Municipal Government set up the Shenzhen Virtual University Park in the Science and Technology Park.
The Mangrove Ecopark was established in the Futian District as the smallest national park.
The intermediate court sentenced former customs commissioner to life imprisonment.
